title: Director of Administration, Residential Communities
bio: I am the Director of Administration for the Residential Communities of the DSO. In this role, I co-manage the House Administrators as well as oversee the Residential Communities Budgets. I also serve as an HR resource for the roles in the Residential Communities as well. I formerly was the Quincy House Administrator managing all aspects of student housing as well as House events and finances for our community of approximately 460 undergraduates. I also worked for the Accessible Education Office (now the Disability Access Office) from 2010-2013 where I provided counseling, problem solving and advocacy for undergraduate and graduate students with disabilities and medical conditions. I live in Arlington with my partner and three kids. My life revolves around them apart from work. I also like to bake and cheer on the US Women's and Men's Soccer team.
